questions.q: In the lab's Sales Pipeline Overview build, what report type does the pipeline-by-stage report start from?
options: Leads
Accounts
Opportunities
Cases
questions.explain: Pipeline reporting is built on the Opportunities report type, filtered to open deals and grouped by Stage, as covered in Lesson 19.

questions.q: Why does the lab add a dashboard filter on Owner instead of building a separate dashboard per rep?
options: Filters are required before a dashboard can be saved
Salesforce doesn't allow more than one dashboard per folder
A single dashboard filter lets any rep narrow the same dashboard to their own deals interactively
Owner filters are the only filter type Salesforce supports
questions.explain: A dashboard filter (Lesson 16) is the interactive, viewer-facing tool that lets one dashboard definition serve many people's individual views without duplicating the build.

questions.q: According to the lab's self-review checklist, what should load above the fold on the finished dashboard?
options: A text widget listing every report used
The least important widget, to build suspense
The funnel — the most important view
The dashboard's folder sharing settings
questions.explain: Following the design habits from Lesson 18, the most important view (the funnel, answering the core pipeline question) should be visible without scrolling.

questions.q: What does completing the Reports & Dashboards course close out in the Salesforce Administrator path?
options: The Salesforce Administration stage, whose checkpoint is the Salesforce Certified Administrator credential
The Advanced stage of the path
The entire Salesforce Administrator path, including Declarative Development
Nothing; it's a standalone course outside any path
questions.explain: Reports & Dashboards is the final course in the Salesforce Administration stage, which carries the Salesforce Certified Administrator certification checkpoint. Declarative Development, starting with Platform App Builder, comes next.

questions.q: What is the next course in the Salesforce Administrator path after Reports & Dashboards?
options: Salesforce Platform App Builder
Salesforce Flow Automation
Salesforce Business Process Automation
Salesforce Data Management
questions.explain: Salesforce Platform App Builder is the first course of the Declarative Development stage, immediately following Reports & Dashboards and the Salesforce Administration stage's certification checkpoint.
